title: KolTa: A Physics-Informed Active Learning Framework for Formulation Discovery with Limited Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.06394v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Finding high-performing formulations is difficult when few have been measured and experimental budgets are limited. We propose KolTa, an active learning framework that selects batches to discover the top 5% of formulations at a target temperature under a fixed query budget. KolTa combines a three-stage predictor of component contributions, role-conditioned interactions, and anchored temperature response with task-specific soft physics constraints. Its Physics-Residual-Calibrated Upper Confidence Bound (PRC-UCB) acquisition rule combines predicted utility, ensemble disagreement, and a target-temperature physics residual, with nonnegative exploration weights fitted to out-of-fold signed errors. We evaluate the framework on three measured tasks and one simulated task covering binary-mixture viscosity, drug solubility, ionic-liquid viscosity, and electrolyte conductivity. translated_title: KolTa：一种基于物理信息的有限数据配方发现主动学习框架
translated_abstract: 在少数配方已被测量且实验预算有限的情况下，寻找高性能配方十分困难。我们提出了KolTa，这是一个主动学习框架，在固定查询预算下通过选择批次来发现目标温度下排名前5%的最优配方。KolTa将一个三阶段预测器（涵盖组分贡献、角色条件相互作用以及锚定温度响应）与任务特定的软物理约束相结合。其物理残差校准上置信界（PRC-UCB）采集规则融合了预测效用、集成分歧度以及目标温度物理残差，并通过拟合折外带符号误差来确定非负探索权重。我们在三个实测任务和一个模拟任务上对该框架进行了评估，涵盖二元混合物粘度、药物溶解度、离子液体粘度和电解质电导率。KolTa在学习曲线下面积均值（AULC）上排名第一或第二。
tldr: KolTa是一个物理信息驱动的主动学习框架，通过结合三阶段预测器与物理残差校准UCB采集规则，在有限实验预算下高效发现目标温度下排名前5%的最优配方。
en_tdlr: KolTa is a physics-informed active learning framework that combines a three-stage predictor with a Physics-Residual-Calibrated UCB acquisition rule to efficiently discover top 5% formulations at a target temperature under limited experimental budgets.
